description: This file defines the Faq class, which extends CRMEntity, representing FAQ entries in a CRM system. It includes methods for managing FAQ data, comments, and related queries.

classes.name: Faq
classes.description: Represents a FAQ entity in the CRM, extending CRMEntity, with methods to handle FAQ data, comments, and report query generation.

methods.name: Faq
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Handles additional operations to save the FAQ module, such as inserting comments.

methods.name: insertIntoFAQCommentTable
methods.description: Inserts a comment related to the FAQ into the vtiger_faqcomments table.

methods.name: getFAQComments
methods.description: Retrieves and formats comments associated with a specific FAQ.

methods.name: generateReportsQuery
methods.description: Constructs the base SQL query for reporting on the FAQ entity.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Provides relation table details for related modules.
